name: Private Foundry endpoint
summary: Foundry account/project exposed via Private Endpoint (no public network access).
description: Azure AI Foundry Private Link makes the project data-plane endpoint resolve to a private IP and disables public network access on the Foundry account. This lets users run BYOM feature probes without exposing Foundry or APIM endpoints publicly.
notes:
Verified end-to-end by running the matrix from inside the private VNet against a Foundry account with public network access disabled. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/how-to/configure-private-link.

Every passing feature test in this environment also validates private Foundry reachability.

A screenshot captured for this card (`screenshots/01-networking-blade.png`) shows a *different*, disposable Foundry account with `Allow access from: All networks` selected -- that resource was intentionally left public for portal-UI screenshot capture convenience (browser automation can't reach a PE-only endpoint) and is not the private-networked resource this card's claim is verified against. Treat the screenshot as illustrating where the networking toggle lives in the portal, not as counter-evidence.
